children: Investor sentiment in the cryptocurrency market edged higher.
BlockBeats reported on October 25 that Alternative's Crypto Fear and Greed Index stood at 54, up three points from 51 a day earlier. Market sentiment remained in greed territory.
The index is calculated on a scale of 0 to 100 and reflects volatility, trading volume, social media interest, market surveys, Bitcoin market share and Google search trends.

title: Crypto Fear and Greed Index Rises to 54 From 51, Remains in Greed Territory
